title: Annotatio VI §.VIII close: fortify Evangelic consensus; truth in love; Jubilee — DEI SOLIUS GLORIAM
pass_a_gloss: Let therefore both parties further fortify this way already then fortified. Let the Fundamental Consensus of Evangelicals — i.e. between Lutherans and Reformed — striking all eyes, be openly confessed; concerning the Dissensus that remains, less fundamental, by conferring placidly among themselves, piously meditating and searching the revealed Truth, constituting no Dogma necessary to faith and salvation outside Revelation, tolerating those erring and weak in faith, interceding for them before God as faith’s kin — let it be lessened and studied to be taken from the midst; Let all Doctors of both parties be mindful again and again of speaking the truth in love, that so all assemblies of both parties may grow in mutual sincere charity into him who is the head, namely Christ, from whom the whole body fitly framed grows, until at last we each arrive at one faith through all and Knowledge of the Son of GOD, and become perfect to the measure of perfect Christianity, truly thus to be called peaceful and sons of GOD — and the Jubilee Feast soon to be celebrated with the Marchic Church and University, to be continued with sempiternal Solemnity unto the GLORY OF GOD ALONE.
pass_b_english: Both sides should fortify that already-open way: confess the fundamental Evangelic consensus (Lutheran–Reformed) in the open; treat the lesser remaining dissent with calm conference, revealed truth, no extra-revelatory necessary dogmas, tolerance, and prayer for weaker kin.

Doctors of both sides: speak the truth in love, grow into Christ the head, unto one faith and knowledge of the Son — peaceful sons of God — and keep the coming Marchic Jubilee in everlasting solemnity unto the GLORY OF GOD ALONE. Annotatio VI closes.
source_text: Aditum itaque hunc jam tum munitum, muniat ampliùs utraque pars. Fundamentalem Consensum Evangelicorum, i. e. Lutheranos inter & Reformatos, omnium oculos perstringentem, apertè fateatur; De Dissensu qui restat, minus fundamentali, placidè inter se conferendo, Veritatem revelatam piè meditando, scrutando, nullum, extra Revelationem, ad fidem & salutem necessarium Dogma constituendo, errantes infirmósque in fide tolerando, pro istis, ceu fidei consanguineis, apud Deum precibus intercedendo, minuat éque medio tollere studeat; Omnes utriusque partis Doctores memores identidem sint loquendi veritatem in charitate, ut sic utriusque partis cœtus omnes in sincera charitate mutua adolescant in eum, qui est caput, nempe Christus, ex quo totum corpus congruenter coagmentatum succrescit, donec tandem singuli perveniamus ad unam per omnia fidem & Cognitionem filii DEI, perfectíque evadamus ad mensuram perfectæ Christianitatis, verè sic pacifici & filii DEI nuncupandi Festúmque Jubilare, cum Ecclesia & Universitate Marchica, mox celebrandum, sempiternâ Solennitate continuaturi in DEI SOLIUS GLORIAM.
notes: Consensus; truth in love; Jubilee; Annot. VI end.
